about: Files the creature bodies are built from. All are MakeHuman assets, released as CC0 1.0 in September 2020 (https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/blob/master/LICENSE.md, section C: the base mesh and proxies, targets and modifiers, textures, clothes, poses and expressions). Each is fetched once into target/creature-sources/ and checked by its SHA-1 before it is read.
authors: MakeHuman team (Manuel Bastioni; Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier)

base.obj.what: the hm08 base mesh: skin, helpers, joint helpers, UVs

macro/male-old-thin.what: an old man with no muscle and no weight

macro/female-young-thin.what: a young woman with no muscle and no weight

macro/male-young-thin.what: a young man with no muscle and no weight

macro/male-old.what: an old man's face and skin

macro/male-old-thin-tall.what: the same, at the greatest height
